book.name: Aisaiya
book.title: Aisaiya Aisaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: Aisaiya bin dalimbat King Hesakaiya wanim YAWEI bin tok
Wal Merodakbaladan, det san blanga Beiladan bin jidan king blanga Bebalon na. En wen imbin irrim det King Hesakaiya bin orait, imbin jandim leda en presen blanga im.

Wal King Hesakaiya bin welkam detlot hubin garrimap det leda blanga im, en imbin shoum olabat detlot silba, en detlot gol, en detlot gudwan sid daga, en detlot gudbala oil langa im stowa rum. Imbin shoum olabat weya imbin oldei kipum ol detlot enijing blanga yusumbat langa wo, en langa det king haus imbin shoumbat olabat ebrijing. Imbin shoum ebrijing langa ol im kantri du.
Wal aibin tok langa King Hesakaiya na, “Weya dislot mesinja bin kaman brom? Wanim olabat wandim?” En King Hesakaiya bin tok, “Olabat bin kaman olawei brom Bebalon.”
Wal aibin tok, “Wanim yubin shoum olabat?” En King Hesakaiya bin tok, “Aibin shoum olabat ebrijing na weya im jidan langa main kantri.”
Wal aibin tok langa det king na, “Ai garram nyus blanga yu brom YAWEI det boswan God.

Wandei ol detlot gudbala ting weya yu en yu grengrenfathamob bin pudumweibat insaid langa yu haus, detlot Bebalon pipul garra deigimwei langa olabat kantri na, en nomo enijing kaan jidan deya blanga yu. Lagijat na YAWEI bin pramis.
Yu ronwan sanmob garra go langa Bebalon du weya olabat garra jidan sheimwan, en olabat garra oldei wekwekbat blanga det king langa im speshalwan haus.”
Wal King Hesakaiya bin tok, “Det mesij yubin bringimap brom YAWEI im brabli gudwan.” Dumaji imbin reken blanga im kantri garra jidan gudbalawei raidap langa det taim im garra dai.
